title: The identity of an organisation a document names
description: An energy community's identity is a snapshot of the rec-registry (community.legal, community.contact). Every other party's lives in the deployment's parties file. "[•]" is a value nobody has supplied yet.

key.description: the registry community key (energy communities only)

short.description: the name the texts use after the first mention

term.description: the term a text defines for the party in quotes, when it is not the short name (e.g. a platform operator's)

display_name.description: the name the organisation presents to members (e.g. in an app and in consent texts), when it is neither the legal name nor the short name

meter_export_format.description: the name of the format in which a grid operator exports meter readings

registered_office.description: street, postcode, city (province), without the country

city.description: the city of the operating site

forum.description: the city whose courts have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes under the party's agreements (a dataspace)

aliases.description: other names the party goes by, e.g. its dataspace participant alias in offer recipients
